title: feat: add black-forest-labs/flux.2-max via Replicate
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15140

## Summary
- Adds `black-forest-labs/flux.2-max` as a new paid-only image model (no aliases)
- Azure AI Foundry (the route used for `flux.2-pro`/`flux.2-flex`) does not offer Max — confirmed against Microsoft's own docs/blog, which list only `[flex]` and `[pro]` in the BFL collection. Replicate, already integrated for this exact model family (`flux.2-pro`, `flux.1-kontext-pro` both use it as a fallback), becomes FLUX.2 Max's **primary** route — the first time Replicate is used as primary for this specific model family (it's already primary elsewhere: seedream, ideogram, wan, qwen-image, krea)
- Fallback: OpenRouter, pinned to BFL's own `black-forest-labs/us-3` deployment (its only endpoint)

## Contract (confirmed)
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Canonical name | `black-forest-labs/flux.2-max` |
| Aliases | none |
| `priceMultiplier` | 1 |
| `paidOnly` | yes |
| Registry provider | `replicate` |
| Primary route | Replicate, `black-forest-labs/flux-2-max` |
| Fallback | OpenRouter, `black-forest-labs/us-3` tag |
| Pollinations GPU | no |

## Pricing (live-verified 2026-09-13)
- **Replicate** (primary): $0.04/run + $0.03/input megapixel + $0.03/output megapixel (fetched directly from the model's Replicate page)
- **OpenRouter** (fallback): $0.07/output megapixel flat, no input charge (fetched via `/api/v1/images/models/black-forest-labs/flux.2-max/endpoints`)
- Both cap at 8 reference images per request

## Fallback candidates considered
- **Vercel AI Gateway** (`bfl/flux-2-max`): rejected — its listing shows unpublished `$0`/`$0` pricing and declares text-only input (no image-editing support), unlike Replicate/OpenRouter's confirmed 8-reference editing.
- **Fireworks**: no confirmed direct hosting of this specific checkpoint.

## Implementation
- `shared/registry/image.ts`: new primary entry, with a `billing.adjustments` rule for Replicate's flat $0.04 execution fee (same mechanism already used for `flux.2-pro`'s Replicate fallb
